name: fix_axum_wrong_status_code
description: Fixes an Axum create-item endpoint that incorrectly returns 200 instead of 201
prompts: The Axum app in src/main.rs has a POST /items endpoint meant to create a new item and store it in shared in-memory state. QA reports that even though the item is created successfully, the endpoint returns HTTP 200 OK instead of the correct HTTP 201 Created status code. Fix src/main.rs so POST /items returns 201 Created on success, without changing any other behavior (GET /items must keep working exactly as before). The server listens on 0.0.0.0:8042.

setup_files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "items_status"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
